query: I'm thirsty all the time and keep getting up at night to pee. I've lost weight without trying and my eyesight has gone blurry.
I wheeze and can't catch my breath when I exercise or breathe cold air. My chest feels tight and I keep coughing at night.
My hands shake when they are resting. I move slowly, my muscles are stiff, and I shuffle and lose my balance when I walk.
I keep forgetting recent conversations and where I put things. I get lost in familiar places and feel confused about what day it is.
I get a pounding headache on one side of my head, bright lights bother me, and I feel sick to my stomach. Sometimes I see spots before it starts.
The pain started around my belly button and moved to the lower right side of my stomach. I have a fever, threw up twice and don't feel like eating.
It burns when I pee, I have to go constantly, and my urine is cloudy and smells bad.
I get burning in my chest after meals, especially when lying down, and a sour taste comes up into my throat.
I have sudden severe pain in my side and back that comes in waves, and there's blood in my urine.
There is crushing pressure in the middle of my chest spreading to my left arm and jaw. I'm sweating and short of breath.
One side of my face drooped, my arm went weak and numb, and my speech came out slurred all of a sudden.
I'm tired all the time, always cold, gaining weight, constipated, and my skin is dry and my hair is thinning.
My heart races, I've lost weight even though I eat a lot, my hands tremble, I sweat too much and my eyes seem to bulge.
I feel hopeless and sad most days, I've lost interest in things I used to enjoy, I can't sleep and I have no energy.
Out of nowhere my heart pounds, I can't breathe, I feel dizzy and I'm terrified something awful is happening.
I came down suddenly with a high fever, chills, body aches, a dry cough and I'm completely wiped out.
I have a runny stuffy nose, I keep sneezing, a mild sore throat and a little cough.
My throat is so sore that it hurts to swallow, the glands in my neck are swollen and I have a fever.
I'm coughing up thick yellow mucus, have a high fever and chills, and it hurts in my chest when I breathe in.
Both of my hands and wrists are swollen and painful, and my joints are especially stiff for hours every morning.
My big toe suddenly became red, hot, swollen, and so painful that I can't even stand a bedsheet touching it.
My thumb and fingers go numb and tingle at night, and my wrist aches, and my grip has become weak.
Sharp pain shoots from my lower back down the back of my leg to my foot, and my leg feels numb.
I get a stabbing pain in the bottom of my heel when I take my first steps in the morning.
I get cramping belly pain and bloating, and I go back and forth between diarrhea and constipation, which gets better after using the toilet.
I've had bloody diarrhea for weeks with cramps in my belly, weight loss and tiredness.
After fatty meals I get severe pain in my upper right abdomen that goes through to my back, along with nausea.
I look pale, I'm exhausted and short of breath on stairs, I feel dizzy and my hands and feet are always cold.
My eye is red and itchy, with sticky discharge that glues my eyelids together in the morning.
My vision has gradually become cloudy, with glare and halos around headlights at night.
My child has a bad earache with a fever, is pulling on the ear and can't hear well.
The room spins when I roll over in bed or look up, and it makes me feel nauseous and unsteady.
I have itchy, dry, red, cracked patches of skin on the inside of my elbows that flare up and sometimes ooze.
I have thick red patches with silvery scales on my elbows and scalp, and my skin is itchy and flaking.
A band of painful blisters appeared on one side of my torso, and the skin there burned for a few days before the rash came.
My kid has itchy fluid-filled spots all over the body, with a mild fever and feeling unwell.
I snore loudly and my partner says I stop breathing in my sleep. I wake up with headaches and I'm sleepy all day.
I lie awake for hours, can't fall asleep or stay asleep, and I feel tired and irritable during the day.
One of my calves became swollen, warm and painful after a long flight, and the skin looks red.
I suddenly got sharp chest pain and shortness of breath, my heart is racing and I coughed up some blood.
I've had seizures where my body jerks and I pass out. Afterwards I'm confused and don't remember anything.
I have a terrible headache, a stiff neck and high fever, and light hurts my eyes.
I have intense itching down there and thick white vaginal discharge, and it burns during sex.
I'm an older man with a weak urine stream, I struggle to start peeing, and I wake up several times at night to go.
It feels like a tight band squeezing around my head, with sore neck and shoulder muscles when I'm stressed.
I hear a constant ringing in my ears, even in a quiet room, and it's keeping me from concentrating.
I have a throbbing toothache that is worse when I bite, and my gum and cheek are swollen.
I see bright red blood on the toilet paper and I have itching and a painful lump around my anus.
I missed my period and now I've got sharp one-sided pelvic pain, spotting and feel faint.
I'm very thirsty with a dry mouth and dark urine, and I feel dizzy when I stand up.
I bleed after sex and between periods, and I've got a watery discharge with an odor.
After hiking I found a bull's-eye rash on my leg, and I've had fever, fatigue and aching joints.
Since the accident I have nightmares and flashbacks, I jump at loud noises, and I avoid driving.
My ear hurts when I tug on it and it's itchy with some drainage after a week of swimming.
I'm a smoker with a cough that won't go away, I'm coughing blood, and I've lost weight.
I get a tingling and then little blisters on my lip that crust over, usually when I'm stressed.
I have severe upper belly pain that goes through to my back, it's worse after eating, and I keep vomiting.
My toddler has a cough that sounds like a seal barking, and a harsh noise when breathing in at night.
I suddenly saw a lot of floaters and flashes, and a dark curtain is coming over part of my vision.
My periods are incredibly painful, sex hurts deep inside, and we've had trouble getting pregnant.
There's a swelling at the front of my neck that makes it feel tight when I swallow.
I'm 34 weeks pregnant with a bad headache, swollen face and hands, and I see flashing lights.
I've had a deep pain in my thigh bone that's worse at night and there's a swelling above my knee.
I'm tired and weak, I've lost weight, my skin has darkened and I crave salt and get dizzy when I stand.
I'm an older woman who's gotten shorter and hunched, and I broke my wrist from a small fall.
I'm barely peeing, my legs are swollen, I feel sick to my stomach and my skin itches.
I fall asleep suddenly in the middle of the day, even while talking, and my knees buckle when I laugh.
I've had a chesty cough with mucus for a week since my cold, and my chest is sore.
My child keeps getting lung infections, has greasy stools, isn't growing well, and tastes salty when kissed.
I was working outside in the heat and now I'm confused with hot dry skin, a pounding headache, and I stopped sweating.
I've got painful blisters and sores on my genitals that come back every few months.
Right after eating peanuts my lips swelled up, I broke out in hives, and my throat felt tight.
My heart flutters and beats irregularly, and I feel lightheaded and tired.
I rolled my ankle on the stairs and now it's swollen and bruised and hurts to walk on.
I'm 25 with back pain and stiffness that's worst in the morning and improves with exercise.
My periods are irregular, I'm growing hair on my chin, I have acne and can't lose weight.
My periods are very heavy and long, I feel pressure in my pelvis, and I pee a lot.
The whole family has had vomiting and watery diarrhea for a day with cramps and a low fever.
My eyelids droop and I see double by evening, and my arms get weak the more I use them.
I get sudden painful tightening in my calf at night that makes me jump out of bed.
I felt lightheaded in a hot room, everything went dark, and I passed out for a few seconds.
I've got a high fever, a racing heart and fast breathing, I'm confused, and I had an infection days ago.
My lower back hurts after lifting boxes, it's stiff in the morning and it's hard to bend.
My calves cramp when I walk a couple of blocks and it goes away when I rest. My feet are cold.
At night I get a crawling feeling in my legs and I have to get up and move them to make it stop.
Blood keeps dripping from one nostril and it's hard to stop even when I pinch it.
I itch terribly at night, especially between my fingers, and there are tiny lines on my skin. My roommate has it too.
After a trip to Southeast Asia I've got a high fever, severe pain behind my eyes, and bones that ache terribly.
I have sudden episodes of severe pain in my bones, I'm anemic, and it runs in my family.
I've got a gnawing burn in my upper stomach that gets better when I eat and wakes me up at night.
My ankles are swollen, I get out of breath walking across the room, and I need extra pillows to sleep.
A rash came up across my cheeks and nose, my joints hurt, I'm exhausted, and sunlight makes it all worse.
I've got jerky movements I can't control, my mood swings badly, and my father had the same thing.
I can't get or keep an erection firm enough for sex, and it's been happening for months.
Itchy raised welts keep popping up on my skin and moving around, and each lasts a few hours.
I weigh far too much for my height, my joints ache, and I get winded easily.
My toddler has a fever, sores in her mouth and small blisters on her hands and feet.
A few hours after eating at a buffet I started vomiting, having watery diarrhea and stomach cramps.
I have a high fever, shaking chills, and pain in my side and back, plus burning when I pee.
My son has honey-colored crusty sores around his mouth that are spreading.
I get shaky, sweaty and confused when I haven't eaten, and I feel better after juice.
Weeks after unprotected sex I had fever, swollen glands, a rash and a sore throat, and now I keep getting infections.
The center of my vision is blurry and straight lines look wavy, but I'm fine at the edges.
I hear voices no one else hears, I think people are watching me, and my thoughts get jumbled.
My son bruises easily and his joints bleed and swell, and small cuts take forever to stop.
My cheeks and nose stay flushed and red with small bumps, and it's worse after wine or spicy food.
I've got a red, itchy ring-shaped patch on my arm that has a clear center.
I have a painful red bump on the edge of my eyelid.
My eyes feel gritty, burn and get tired when I read or use my computer.
After milk or ice cream I get gassy and bloated and have to run to the bathroom.
My voice has gone hoarse and I can barely talk, and my throat is scratchy.
I've been a heavy drinker, my belly is swollen with fluid, my skin looks yellow and I bruise easily.
I have pain in the lower left side of my belly with fever and a change in my bowel habits.
A bat bit me weeks ago, and now I have fever, confusion and I panic when I try to drink water.
I'm terrified of gaining weight, I barely eat, my periods stopped, and people tell me I'm too thin.
My hand has grown weak and the muscles are shrinking and twitching, and lately my speech has started to slur.
I see blood in my pee but it doesn't hurt, and I have to go more often.
I have a deep pulsing feeling in my belly near my navel and a steady ache in my back.
I eat huge amounts in secret and then make myself throw up, and my throat and teeth are starting to suffer.
Food gets stuck when I swallow, first solids and now liquids too, and I'm losing weight.
I only go to the bathroom a couple of times a week, it's hard and painful to pass and I have to strain.
I have small painful white ulcers inside my lip that sting when I eat.
I have a bulge in my groin that gets bigger when I cough or lift and aches by the end of the day.
The week before my period I get irritable, bloated, and my breasts are sore.
I found a hard lump in my breast, the skin looks dimpled and my nipple has turned inward.
I'm 70, my urine stream is slow, and I've had blood in my semen and pain in my hips.
I can't focus on anything for long, I lose things all the time, and I interrupt people and can't sit still.
I worry about everything all day and can't shut it off. My muscles are tense and I can't relax or sleep.
I got back from Africa and have cycles of shaking chills, high fever and heavy sweats every couple of days.
I'm 51, my periods have stopped, I get hot flashes and night sweats, and I'm moody.
My hands and feet tingle, my tongue is sore and red, and I'm tired and forgetful.
My bones ache, my muscles are weak, and I hardly ever get any sun.
I keep getting infections, I bruise and bleed easily, and I'm pale and tired all the time.
I keep checking the locks and washing my hands over and over because I can't get rid of the thoughts unless I do.
Whenever I eat bread or pasta I get bloated with diarrhea, and I'm losing weight and low on iron.
I've slowly been losing my side vision, and I sometimes see halos and get eye pain.
The point of my hip is sore and tender, and it hurts to lie on that side at night.
I have a hard lump under my right ribs, my stomach is swollen, and I've lost a lot of weight.
I stepped on a rusty nail last week and now my jaw is locked and my neck and back muscles spasm.
It's a sharp, tearing pain when I poop and I see a streak of blood on the paper.
I had a painless sore on my genitals that went away, and now I've got a rash on my palms and soles.
My gums are puffy and red, they bleed when I brush, and I've got bad breath.
After a day at the beach my shoulders are red, hot and painful, and now they're blistering.
I have painless lumps in my neck and armpits, with night sweats, fever and weight loss.
I feel full after a few bites, my upper stomach hurts, and I've been losing weight and feeling weak.
I woke up and one side of my face wouldn't move. I can't close that eye or smile evenly.
I have a dull ache and fullness on one side of my lower belly and pain during sex.
I'm a college student, wiped out for weeks with a sore throat, fever and swollen neck glands.
I leak urine when I cough, laugh or jump, and I can't always reach the toilet on time.
I've got pimples and blackheads all over my face and back, and some leave scars.
I've turned yellow, I have pain in my upper belly going to my back, and my appetite is gone.
I have small rough bumps on my fingers that have slowly grown and don't hurt.
I lost my sense of taste and smell, I have a fever, a dry cough and I'm exhausted.
I got a sudden sharp pain on one side of my chest and I can't get a full breath.
My skin and the whites of my eyes turned yellow, my urine is dark, and I feel tired and sick.
After a virus I developed chest pain, a racing heart, and I get winded easily.
My daughter's shoulders look uneven and her spine seems to curve to one side.
My son doesn't make eye contact, doesn't talk much, and gets upset if his routine changes.
My vision went blurry in one eye and it hurt to move it. Weeks later my legs went numb and tingly, and heat makes me weaker.
The outside of my elbow hurts when I grip things or turn a door handle.
My face hurts around my nose and eyes, it's worse when I bend over, and I've got thick green snot.
I have coughing fits so hard I can't breathe in and I make a high sound, and sometimes I vomit afterward.
My jaw clicks and hurts when I chew and sometimes it locks when I open my mouth.
I have sharp chest pain that gets worse when I lie flat or breathe in and gets better when I lean forward.
A mole on my back has grown, has uneven edges and several colors, and sometimes bleeds.
My hair is coming out in round bald patches and my scalp looks smooth there.
Every spring my nose runs, I sneeze, and my eyes itch and water.
There's unusual discharge and burning when I pee a couple of weeks after a new partner.
My headaches keep getting worse and are worst in the morning. I've been vomiting and my personality has changed.
The skin between my toes is itchy, peeling and cracked, and my feet smell.
My lower leg is red, hot, swollen and tender, the redness is spreading, and I have a fever.
After a bee sting my throat closed up, my tongue swelled, I couldn't breathe and I nearly passed out.
My face has gotten round, I've gained weight around my belly, I have purple stretch marks and I bruise easily.
My unvaccinated child has a high fever, runny nose and red eyes, and a blotchy rash that started on the face.
I have a painful red lump full of pus on my thigh that keeps getting bigger.
I hurt all over my body for months, I wake up unrefreshed, and my thinking feels foggy.
My ear feels plugged and muffled and it got worse after using cotton swabs.
I feel fine mostly, but I get headaches and the machine at the pharmacy keeps showing high readings.
My shoulder has gotten stiffer and more painful for months, and I can't lift my arm over my head.
My cheeks are swollen on both sides near my jaw, I've got a fever and it hurts to chew.
A week after a stomach bug my feet began tingling, and now the weakness is climbing up both legs.
My doctor's blood test showed high fats and I've got yellow bumps around my eyelids.
My knees ache and creak, especially after I've been on my feet, and they feel stiff for a few minutes when I get up.
I've smoked for thirty years. I cough up mucus every morning and I get out of breath doing small chores.
My whole family got headaches, dizziness and nausea in the house with the old furnace, and we feel better outside.
I've had more trouble following conversations and I need the TV much louder than my family does.
My daughter keeps scratching her head and I can see tiny white specks stuck to her hair.
I've been coughing for over a month, sometimes with blood, and I have night sweats and weight loss.
My fingers turn white and then blue when I'm cold, and they throb when they warm up.
I'm ten weeks pregnant and I feel queasy and throw up most mornings.
I found a hard painless lump on one of my testicles and that side feels heavy.
I've noticed blood in my stool, my bowel habits have changed, and I've been losing weight without trying.
I hit my head playing soccer and now I have a headache, feel foggy, and can't remember the game.
I get electric shock pains in my cheek and jaw when I chew or touch my face.
I go for weeks barely sleeping, spending too much money and full of big plans, and then I crash and can't get out of bed.
My knee popped when I landed from a jump, then it swelled up and feels like it gives way.
The veins in my legs are big, twisted and blue, and my legs ache and feel heavy after standing.
I can't stop drinking once I start, I get shaky in the morning without a drink, and it's hurting my job.
